name: @fahrizkyputra/pi-modes
description: Selectable, independent agent modes for Pi. /gercep: no tests/typecheck/lint/build, ends with a manual QA checklist. /hati-hati: confirm every risky command, ends with a rollback section. /auto-effort: a small judge model sets thinking per prompt. /auto-review and /review: an independent reviewer model checks each task's diff (across every repository of a monorepo folder) and sends critical/major findings back to fix. Default stays untouched.
author: Fahrizky Putra

scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/e2e-gercep.mjs && node scripts/e2e-careful.mjs && node scripts/e2e-effort.mjs && node scripts/e2e-review.mjs && node scripts/e2e-monorepo.mjs
